core.metanarrative_position: Cycle 2 synthesis integrates biblical literacy, interpretation, worship, character, relationships, service, and continued growth.

claims.statement: Biblical learning aims at understanding that shapes worship, character, relationships, service, and continued growth.
claims.interpretive_hinge: This is the curriculum’s formation architecture, drawing together recurring biblical aims rather than quoting a single passage that specifies the four-stage model.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not claim the Know-Understand-Practise-Become model is itself a biblical command.

claims.statement: Review should reconnect knowledge with concrete faithful practices rather than treating recall alone as spiritual maturity.
claims.interpretive_hinge: The curriculum distinguishes content mastery from formation and uses review to reconnect the two.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not equate lesson completion with spiritual maturity.

core.interpretation_skill: Locate on timeline; read immediate context; identify genre; separate observation and application

activities.title: Know Understand Practise Become Review
steps: Read the selected evidence and record direct observations.
Place observations, interpretations, framework choices, or prudential applications into the resource categories.
Discuss which conclusions require more than direct textual wording.
Write one careful response that follows from the evidence.
activities.learning_link: Makes the lesson’s evidence classification and formation aim visible.
activities.low_resource_alternative: Draw the categories on blank paper or complete the exercise verbally.

activities.title: Evidence Class Check
steps: Read several statements connected to the lesson.
Classify each as text observation, synthesis, framework choice, prudential judgment, or application.
Return to the evidence and justify each classification.
activities.low_resource_alternative: Use verbal responses instead of written cards.
